and the 37 that can do it.

Monday morning37 tables

Every table here is physically on the shelf in a London IKEA tonight, with the branch and the count read live from IKEA’s stock API. This is the only route on this page that ends with a table in your flat on Monday morning. Stores open Sunday 11:00–17:00 and again on the bank holiday: Wembley 10:00–22:00, Croydon, Greenwich and Oxford Street 10:00–21:00, Hammersmith 10:00–20:00. Buying in store also unlocks £29 store delivery and same-day Taskrabbit.

The wider field — none of it arrives Monday

After Monday153 tables

Sklum ships from Spain. Habitat and Argos put large furniture on standard delivery at 5–7 working days — Fast Track is for small items and does not cover a dining table, so neither of your two picks can make Monday. Heal’s, Danetti, dusk., Rose & Grey and Atkin & Thyme all quote multi-week lead times. Worth seeing if you would rather wait for the right table than have one by Monday.

What I would do

  • Go to Wembley tomorrow. It is open Sunday 11:00–17:00, it holds the deepest stock of any London branch tonight (78 LISABO 140×78, 44 ÅLHULT, 26 MARIEDAMM 180×100), and it opens longest on the bank holiday, 10:00–22:00. Croydon and Greenwich are the next best.
  • Buy it Sunday, not Monday. Monday works — every London store opens at 10:00 — but "Monday morning" then means 10:30 at the earliest, and only if the stock survives Sunday. Going Sunday removes the race.
  • Ø120 SKOGSTA is the round one to beat at £299: solid acacia, black frame, in stock at all five branches. The acacia is warmer and more figured than your floor, so it contrasts rather than near-misses, and the black frame is the only thing on this page that answers your two black pendants.
  • If a rectangle is acceptable, TONSTAD 150×80 at £249 is the best-made thing in the in-store list, and Croydon has 43 of them.
  • Your two Habitat picks cannot make Monday. Large Habitat furniture goes on Argos standard delivery at 5–7 working days; Fast Track is small items only. They are still on this page, in the third section, if you would rather wait.
  • Measure before you go. A Ø120 circle needs about 3.0 m of clear floor once chairs move; 120×80 against a wall needs far less. Your two pendants hang in a line, which is an argument for a rectangle.
Store-level stock, prices and opening hours read live from IKEA’s UK stock and store APIs on Saturday 29 August 2026 at 20:30. Stock moves fast on a bank holiday weekend — a count here is evidence a branch had one this evening, not a reservation. Ring the store, or use Click & Collect to hold it.

Sklum figures come from its own product data across all 94 of its dining tables. Heal’s, Danetti, dusk., Rose & Grey and Atkin & Thyme come from their public Shopify catalogues; only those whose listing states a size are shown, so their sections under-represent what those shops sell. Habitat cards carry no price because habitat.co.uk and argos.co.uk block automated requests outright — only their image CDN answers.

Correction to the desk page: it says Wembley opens its collection point at 07:00. That 07:00–11:00 window is IKEA’s parcel lockers, which cannot dispense a dining table, and it says Argos Fast Track excludes bank holidays. Fast Track does run on bank holidays — it simply does not carry large furniture. Both claims are wrong as applied to a table.
